subject: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@sentinelhealth.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Anil Mehra <anil.mehra@sentinelhealth.io>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch

Hi Olga,

Quick note from our side — we’re running a 1-week pilot of Redwood-powered summarization for our clinician portal (internal beta) from Dec 15–19. After load testing, we expect a short multi-hour spike each day around 11:00–14:00 PT as clinics ship end-of-day notes. Peak characteristics: ~150 concurrent requests, average 3k tokens/context, estimated 280k tokens per hour during the window.

We’re concerned the standard rate caps and fairness throttles will start shed traffic at P95+ and that will cause visible errors for clinicians. Can Redwood provide a temporary exception (burst window) for those dates: higher burst allowance, priority routing (no fairness tiebreak), and a latency SLO for p50/p95? We’re happy to accept a short-term surcharge and provide a formal mutual action plan.

Attached is a short CSV with our predicted schedule and a one-page runbook. Can you loop in whoever owns SLA exceptions?

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Director of ML Platforms, Sentinel Health
attachments: sentinel_pilot_schedule.csv (text/csv, 12KB)
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@sentinelhealth.io>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch

Hi Samira — thanks for the details and the schedule. This is the right time to surface it. I’m looping in Vivek (AE) and Marissa (SLA/Product) so we can propose an operationally-safe carveout that won’t impact other customers.

A couple clarifying Qs so we size the exception appropriately:
- Can you confirm whether requests are single-shot (one generation call per clinician event) or split into a short generation + long context retrieval pattern?
- Do you need guaranteed P99 latency, or is P95/P50 acceptable for the pilot?
- Is the surcharge OK as a line-item on the existing invoice or would procurement need a contract addendum/DocuSign?

We’ll come back with a proposed window and SLOs by EOD tomorrow.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch

Marissa — forwarding Samira’s schedule. Quick thoughts: 150 concurrent at 3k tokens is non-trivial but short-lived. Product can do a scoped carveout with priority routing and a temporary bump to the per-customer burst token cap, but we should attach an SLA addendum that limits exposure (timebound window, hard ceiling on aggregate tokens, and fallbacks). Rishi — can you confirm the cost delta for a 5-day, 3-hour-per-day priority window (estimate in GPU-hours)? I’d like numbers we can put in the email to the customer.

Thanks,
Vivek
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@sentinelhealth.io>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 14:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch

Hi Samira — thanks for the schedule and runbook. We can support a scoped exception. Proposed carveout (draft):

- Window: Dec 15–19, daily 10:30–14:30 PT (4 hours/day)
- Burst allowance: temporary increase to per-customer burst token cap from 25k to 400k tokens/min for the window
- Aggregate ceiling: 1.1M tokens/day (safety cap). If exceeded, we will throttle to protect platform stability and notify you immediately.
- Priority routing: requests from your API key will be routed to a priority queue; fairness tie-breaks will not hold back your requests during the window unless the aggregate ceiling is hit.
- Latency objective: target p50 = 120 ms, p95 < 600 ms for single-shot generation with <= 4k context under the window; these are operational targets, with an SLA-backed credit at p95 if we miss by > 2 incidents over the week (each incident defined as 5-minute blockage where >10% of requests see >1s latency).
- Cost: temporary surcharge of $0.30 per 1k extra tokens above your baseline commit; approximate estimate for the 5-day window: $3,200. Final invoice line will be added to the Dec statement or via a short DocuSign addendum if procurement prefers.

Attachments: proposed_sla_addendum_v1.pdf (contains formal wording and measurable metrics).

Before we lock this: two operational asks from our side — (1) provide an emergency on-call contact for the pilot window (phone or Slack) and (2) confirm that you can accept additional logging (request ids + trace headers) for the window so we can correlate spikes.

If this looks good, we can send a DocuSign addendum and schedule a quick 15-min ops alignment next week.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@sentinelhealth.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch

Thanks Marissa — overall this works for us. A couple quick confirmations:
- We’ll provide an on-call Slack contact and a phone number for Dec 15–19 (TBD; I’ll share before EOD Friday).
- Logging: yes, we can add trace headers and expose request ids for the pilot.
- Procurement: Anil, the customer procurement owner, will you accept the surcharge as a PO line item or do we need a DocuSign addendum?

Anil / procurement@ — looping you in for contracting. If you need the formal addendum, Marissa attached it.

— Samira
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate/burst exception for pilot launch

Samira / Anil — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps from Redwood:
1) We will generate the DocuSign addendum (based on the attached proposed_sla_addendum_v1.pdf) and send to Anil for signature by end of day tomorrow.
2) Engineering will provision the priority routing and burst bump for API key xxxxx-**** by Dec 14 EOD, and we’ll enable request-level tracing for the window.
3) Finance will add the surcharge as a separate line item on your Dec invoice unless you prefer the signed addendum for PO routing.
4) Ops alignment: Marissa will set a 15-min sync Weds 12/10 at 10:00 PT to confirm runbook and on-call info.

I’ll track this in the deal record (DEAL-2025-578). If anything changes we’ll notify you immediately. Looking forward to a smooth pilot.

— Olga
